### **YouTube Aesthetic Dark Mode | Black & Navy Blue ✨**  
Tired of YouTube’s default look? Transform your experience with this **sleek dark mode** featuring a **black & navy blue color scheme**, glowing buttons, and smooth animations.  

? **Features:**  
✔️ **Elegant Dark Background** (Black & Navy Blue for a premium look)  
✔️ **Glowing Navy Blue Buttons & Search Bar** (Subtle yet stylish glow)  
✔️ **Smooth Hover Effects** (Better user experience)  
✔️ **Custom Loading Animation** (Aesthetic & modern)  

Perfect for **night browsing** or anyone who loves a **clean, stylish, and eye-friendly UI**. Try it out and give YouTube a fresh, aesthetic makeover! ??
